Event ID: 18 (Derived from Section 4.2)
Sentence: "During the EPS attach procedure, the network can activate a default EPS bearer context (i.e. if the UE requests PDN connectivity in the attach request). Additionally, the network can activate one or several dedicated EPS bearer contexts in parallel for PDN connections of IP or Ethernet PDN type. To this purpose the EPS session management messages for the default EPS bearer context activation can be transmitted in an information element in the EPS mobility management messages. In this case, the UE and the network execute the attach procedure, the default EPS bearer context activation procedure, and the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure in parallel. The UE and network shall complete the combined default EPS bearer context activation procedure and the attach procedure before the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure is completed. If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME, then the success of the attach procedure is dependent on the success of the default EPS bearer context activation procedure. If the attach procedure fails, then the ESM procedures also fail"
Start State: UE initiates the EPS attach procedure, and the network is ready to process the attach request.
Condition: The UE requests PDN connectivity in the attach request, and the network supports the activation of default and dedicated EPS bearer contexts.
Action: The network activates a default EPS bearer context and may activate one or several dedicated EPS bearer contexts in parallel. EPS session management messages for default EPS bearer context activation are transmitted within EPS mobility management messages. The UE and network execute the attach procedure, default EPS bearer context activation, and dedicated EPS bearer context activation in parallel. The combined default EPS bearer context activation and attach procedure must complete before the dedicated EPS bearer context activation is finalized. If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported, the attach procedure's success depends on the default EPS bearer context activation. If the attach procedure fails, the ESM procedures also fail.
End State: The UE is attached to the network with a default EPS bearer context activated, and optionally, one or more dedicated EPS bearer contexts are activated. If the attach procedure fails, the UE remains detached, and no ESM procedures are completed.
============================================================
Event ID: 19 (Derived from Section 4.2)
Sentence: "A UE using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization can initiate transport of user data via the control plane. For this purpose a UE in EMM-IDLE mode can initiate the service request procedure and transmit the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message in an information element in the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message"
Start State: UE is in EMM-IDLE mode and is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization.
Condition: The UE needs to transport user data via the control plane.
Action: The UE initiates the service request procedure and transmits the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message as an information element in the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
End State: The UE successfully initiates the transport of user data via the control plane.

End State: ESM message transmission is suspended during EMM procedures (except for attach and service request procedures). During the service request procedure, ESM message transmission may or may not be suspended based on MME decision.

Start State: UE is attempting IMS registration, and conditions a, b, and c have evaluated to false.
Condition: The indication from the upper layers that the UE is available for voice calls in the IMS takes longer than the manufacturer-determined period of time.
Action: The NAS layer assumes the UE is not available for voice calls in the IMS.
End State: The NAS layer concludes that the UE is not available for voice calls in the IMS.

End State: The NAS COUNT value is reset to zero, and the NAS layer continues normal operation with the new COUNT value.

Event ID: 996 (Derived from Section 5.3.2)
Sentence: "The UE shall store a list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming", as well as a list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". These lists shall be erased when the UE is switched off or when the UICC containing the USIM is removed, and periodically (with a period in the range 12 to 24 hours). When the lists are erased, the UE performs cell selection according to 3GPP S 36.304 [21]. One or more tracking areas is removed from the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" in the UE, as well as the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" if, after a subsequent procedure e.g. attach procedure, tracking area updating procedure and GUTI reallocation procedure, one or more tracking areas in the lists is received from the network. If the UE has only one PDN connection established which is for emergency bearer services, the tracking areas shall not be removed from these lists if one or more tracking areas in the lists are received from the network"
Start State: UE maintains lists of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service".
Condition: The UE is switched off, the UICC containing the USIM is removed, or the periodic timer (12 to 24 hours) expires. Alternatively, one or more tracking areas in the lists are received from the network after an attach procedure, tracking area updating procedure, or GUTI reallocation procedure.
Action: The UE erases the lists of forbidden tracking areas. If the lists are erased, the UE performs cell selection according to 3GPP S 36.304 [21]. If tracking areas are received from the network after a subsequent procedure, the UE removes those tracking areas from the lists, unless the UE has only one PDN connection established for emergency bearer services.
End State: The lists of forbidden tracking areas are updated or erased, and the UE performs cell selection if necessary. If the UE has only one PDN connection for emergency bearer services, the lists remain unchanged even if tracking areas are received from the network.

Event ID: 1303 (Derived from Section 5.3.20)
Sentence: "UE radio capability signalling optimisation (RACS) is a feature that is optional at both the UE and the network and which aims to optimise the transmission of UE radio capability over the radio interface (see 3GPP S 23.401 [10]). RACS works by assigning an identifier to represent a set of UE radio capabilities. This identifier is called the UE radio capability ID. A UE radio capability ID can be either manufacturer-assigned or network-assigned. The UE radio capability ID is an alternative to the signalling of the radio capabilities container over the radio interface"
Start State: UE and network have not yet implemented RACS, and UE radio capabilities are transmitted in their full form over the radio interface.
Condition: UE and network support RACS, and there is a need to optimize the transmission of UE radio capabilities over the radio interface.
Action: Assign a UE radio capability ID (either manufacturer-assigned or network-assigned) to represent a set of UE radio capabilities, replacing the need to transmit the full radio capabilities container.
End State: UE radio capabilities are represented by a UE radio capability ID, reducing signalling overhead over the radio interface.

If the lower layer reports a handover failure and the S1 signalling connection still exists, the MME shall also retransmit the EMM INFORMATION message to ensure successful delivery to the UE.
End State: The EMM INFORMATION message is successfully retransmitted by the MME, ensuring its delivery to the UE.

While this timer is running, the UE shall not consider the PLMN + RAT combination that provided this reject cause a candidate for PLMN selection. Action: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, deletes GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, eKSI, and list of equivalent PLMNs, sets the attach attempt counter to 5, starts an implementation-specific timer (2 times the value of T as defined in 3GPP S 23.122 [6]), and excludes the PLMN + RAT combination that provided the reject cause from PLMN selection while the timer is running. Condition: The receiving entity encounters an information element that is either non-existent or not implemented in the current protocol version or configuration.
Action: The receiving entity identifies the issue and may reject the message or ignore the non-existent/not implemented information element, depending on the protocol rules.
End State: The NAS message processing is either aborted or continues without the problematic information element, and an appropriate error handling procedure is initiated.

Event ID: 2289 (Derived from Section 5.5.1.2.7)
Sentence: "This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3450, the attach procedure shall be aborted and the MME enters state EMM-DEREGISTERED. If a new GUTI was allocated in the ATTACH ACCEPT message, the network considers both the old and new GUTI as valid until the old GUTI is invalidated or the EMM context marked as detached is released. If the old GUTI was allocated by a different MME, the current MME does not retain the old GUTI.
End State: The MME is in the EMM-DEREGISTERED state, and the attach procedure is terminated. The network may retain both old and new GUTIs under specific conditions.

Event ID: 2704 (Derived from Section 5.5.2.3.5)
Sentence: "On the first expiry of the timer, the network shall retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message and shall start timer T3422. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3422, the detach procedure shall be aborted. If the detach type is "IMSI detach", or "re-attach not required" and the EMM cause value is #2 "IMSI unknown in HSS", the network shall not change the current EMM state; otherwise the network shall change to state EMM-DEREGISTERED"
Start State: The network is in the process of handling a detach procedure, and a timer has been started.
Condition: The timer associated with the detach procedure expires for the first time.
Action: The network retransmits the DETACH REQUEST message and starts timer T3422. This retransmission is repeated four times. On the fifth expiry of timer T3422, the detach procedure is aborted. If the detach type is "IMSI detach" or "re-attach not required" and the EMM cause value is #2 "IMSI unknown in HSS", the network does not change the current EMM state; otherwise, the network changes to state EMM-DEREGISTERED.
End State: If the detach type is "IMSI detach" or "re-attach not required" with EMM cause #2, the EMM state remains unchanged; otherwise, the network transitions to EMM-DEREGISTERED.

End State: The detach procedure is completed successfully, and the UE transitions to a detached state.

Condition: A collision occurs when the UE initiates a detach procedure while an attach procedure is ongoing, or vice versa.

End State: The UE completes either the detach or attach procedure, and the network state is updated accordingly.

Start State: UE is in idle mode using eDRX, and the network has provided Extended DRX parameters to the UE during the last attach or tracking area updating procedure.
Condition: An incoming mobile terminating SMS is received either within the paging time window or outside the paging time window with a non-zero eDRX value (E-UTRAN eDRX cycle length duration > 5.12 seconds).
Action: The network initiates the paging procedure either immediately (if within the paging time window) or at T time ahead of the next paging time window (if outside the paging time window and eDRX value is non-zero).
End State: The paging procedure is initiated, and the UE is notified of the incoming mobile terminating SMS.

Sentence: "Transaction related procedures use the procedure transaction identity as address parameter in the ESM message header. Event ID: 4664 (Derived from Section 6.3.5)
Sentence: "The network may detect and start performing the APN based congestion control when one or more APN congestion criteria as specified in 3GPP S 23.401 [10] are met. The network may store an APN congestion back-off time on a per UE and congested APN basis. If the UE does not provide an APN for a non-emergency PDN connection, then the MME uses the APN which is used in PDN GW selection procedure as congested APN. When APN based congestion control is active, the network may reject session management requests except the modification of bearer resources requests from UEs or disconnect existing PDN connections with ESM cause value #26 "insufficient resources""
Start State: The network is operating normally without APN-based congestion control.
Condition: One or more APN congestion criteria as specified in 3GPP S 23.401 [10] are met.
Action: The network detects congestion and starts performing APN-based congestion control. It stores an APN congestion back-off time on a per UE and congested APN basis. If the UE does not provide an APN for a non-emergency PDN connection, the MME uses the APN from the PDN GW selection procedure as the congested APN. When congestion control is active, the network may reject session management requests (except modification of bearer resources requests) or disconnect existing PDN connections with ESM cause value #26 "insufficient resources".
End State: APN-based congestion control is active, and the network is managing congestion by rejecting or disconnecting sessions as necessary.

Event ID: 4665 (Derived from Section 6.3.5)
Sentence: "In the UE, EPS session management timers T3396 for APN based congestion control are started and stopped on a per APN basis. The APN associated with T3396 is the APN provided by the UE when the PDN connection is established. If no APN is included in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST or, when applicable, in the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message, then T3396 is associated with no APN. For this purpose the UE shall memorize the APN provided to the network during the PDN connection establishment. The timer T3396 associated with no APN will never be started due to any ESM procedure related to an emergency PDN connection. If the timer T3396 associated with no APN is running or is deactivated, it does not affect the ability of the UE to request an emergency PDN connection"

The UE memorizes the APN provided during PDN connection establishment. T3396 associated with no APN is never started for emergency PDN connections, and its state (running or deactivated) does not impact the UE's ability to request an emergency PDN connection.

Event ID: 4758 (Derived from Section 6.4.1.1)
Sentence: "The purpose of the default bearer context activation procedure is to establish a default EPS bearer context between the UE and the EPC. The default EPS bearer context activation procedure is initiated by the network as a response to the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message from the UE. The default bearer context activation procedure can be part of the attach procedure, and if the attach procedure fails, the UE shall consider that the default bearer activation has implicitly failed. The default EPS bearer context does not have any TFT assigned during the activation procedure. This corresponds to using a match-all packet filter. The network may at anytime after the establishment of this bearer assign a TFT to the default EPS bearer and may subsequently modify the TFT or the packet filters of this default bearer"
Start State: UE has sent a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, and no default EPS bearer context exists between the UE and the EPC.
Condition: The network receives the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message from the UE.
Action: The network initiates the default EPS bearer context activation procedure to establish a default EPS bearer context. During this procedure, no TFT is assigned, and a match-all packet filter is used. The network may later assign or modify the TFT or packet filters for the default EPS bearer.
End State: A default EPS bearer context is established between the UE and the EPC, with no TFT assigned initially, but the network retains the ability to assign or modify TFTs and packet filters post-establishment.
============================================================
Event ID: 4759 (Derived from Section 6.4.1.2)

End State: A default EPS bearer context is established, and the UE can use it for data communication.

Condition: The UE successfully processes the Default EPS Bearer Context Activation Request and decides to accept it.

End State: The default EPS bearer context is successfully activated, and the UE is ready to use the default bearer for data transmission.

Sentence: "Upon receipt of the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, if the UE provided an APN for the establishment of the PDN connection, the UE shall stop timer T3396 if it is running for the APN provided by the UE. Event ID: 4806 (Derived from Section 6.4.1.6)
Sentence: "On the first expiry of the timer T3485, the MME shall resend the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and shall reset and restart timer T3485. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3485, the MME shall release possibly allocated resources for this activation and shall abort the procedure"
Start State: The MME has initiated the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT procedure and is waiting for a response, with timer T3485 running.
Condition: The first expiry of timer T3485 occurs without receiving a response to the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.
Action: The MME resends the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, resets, and restarts timer T3485. This retransmission process is repeated four times. On the fifth expiry of timer T3485, the MME releases any allocated resources for this activation and aborts the procedure.
End State: The ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT procedure is aborted, and any resources allocated for the activation are released.

Start State: UE has an active PDN connection, and timer T3396 may or may not be running depending on the APN and request type.
Condition: Receipt of the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
Action: Upon receiving the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, if the UE provided an APN for the establishment of the PDN connection, it shall stop timer T3396 if it is running for that specific APN. If the UE did not provide an APN and the request type is neither “emergency” nor “handover of emergency bearer services”, the UE shall stop the timer T3396 associated with no APN if it is running. However, if the message is received for an emergency PDN connection, the UE shall not stop the timer T3396 associated with no APN if it is running. After handling the timer, the UE shall check the received Traffic Flow Template (TFT) before taking it into use and then send a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message to the MME.
End State: Timer T3396 is stopped (if applicable), the TFT is checked and taken into use, and the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message is sent to the MME.

Event ID: 5133 (Derived from Section 6.5.1.3)
Sentence: "Upon receipt of the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, the MME checks whether the ESM information transfer flag is included. If the flag is included the MME waits for completion of the ESM information request procedure before proceeding with the PDN connectivity procedure. The MME then checks if connectivity with the requested PDN can be established. If no requested APN is included in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message or the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message and the request type is different from "emergency" and from "handover of emergency bearer services" and from "RLOS", the MME shall use the default APN as the requested APN. If the request type is "emergency" or "handover of emergency bearer services", the MME shall use the APN configured for emergency bearer services or select the statically configured PDN GW for unauthenticated UEs, if applicable. If the request type is "RLOS", the MME shall use the APN configured for RLOS"
Start State: The MME has received a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message from the UE.
Condition: The MME receives the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message and checks for the presence of the ESM information transfer flag.
Action: Upon receiving the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, the MME first checks whether the ESM information transfer flag is included. If the flag is present, the MME shall wait for the completion of the ESM information request procedure before proceeding with the PDN connectivity procedure. Afterward, the MME checks whether connectivity with the requested PDN can be established. If no requested APN is included in either the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message or the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message, and the request type is not “emergency”, not “handover of emergency bearer services”, and not “RLOS”, the MME shall use the default APN as the requested APN. If the request type is “emergency” or “handover of emergency bearer services”, the MME shall use the APN configured for emergency bearer services or select the statically configured PDN-GW for unauthenticated UEs, if applicable. If the request type is “RLOS”, the MME shall use the APN configured for RLOS.
End State: The MME determines the appropriate APN based on the request type and proceeds with establishing connectivity to the requested PDN using the correct configuration.

Event ID: 5401 (Derived from Section 6.5.2.5)
Sentence: "On the first expiry of the timer T3492, the UE shall resend the PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST and shall reset and restart timer T3492. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3492, the UE shall abort the procedure, deactivate all EPS bearer contexts for this PDN connection locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE and the MME, release the PTI allocated for this invocation and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE. Start State: UE is in the process of attempting to disconnect a PDN connection, with timer T3492 running.
Condition: Timer T3492 expires for the first time.
Action: The UE resends the PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST, resets and restarts timer T3492. This retransmission is repeated four times. On the fifth expiry of timer T3492, the UE aborts the procedure, deactivates all EPS bearer contexts for this PDN connection locally without peer-to-peer signalling, releases the PTI allocated for this invocation, and enters the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE. Additionally, upon indication of "back to E-UTRAN coverage" from the lower layers, the UE sends a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with the EPS bearer context status IE to the MME to synchronize EPS bearer contexts status.
End State: The UE is in the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE, and EPS bearer contexts are deactivated locally. The UE is ready to synchronize EPS bearer contexts with the MME upon re-entering E-UTRAN coverage.

While the PTI value is not released, the UE regards any received ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with the same PTI value as a network retransmission (see clause 7.3.1)"
Start State: UE is in an active state with timer T3480 running, awaiting a response to the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message.
Condition: The bearer resource allocation requested is accepted by the network, and the UE receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with a PTI matching the value used in the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message.
Action: The UE stops timer T3480, enters the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE, and ensures the PTI assigned to the procedure is not released immediately. The UE treats any subsequent ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with the same PTI as a network retransmission.
End State: UE is in the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE, with the PTI retained and timer T3480 stopped.

The UE should ensure that the procedure transaction identity (PTI) assigned to this procedure is not released immediately. The way to achieve this is implementation dependent. Action: The UE stops timer T3481, enters the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE, and ensures the PTI is not released immediately. The UE treats subsequent messages with the same PTI as network retransmissions.

Event ID: 5705 (Derived from Section 6.5.4.5)
Sentence: "On the first expiry of the timer T3481, the UE shall resend the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST and shall reset and restart timer T3481. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3481, the UE shall abort the procedure, release the PTI allocated for this activation and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE. In addition, if the UE had initiated resource release for all the traffic flows for the bearer, it shall deactivate the EPS bearer context locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE and the MME. In order to synchronize the EPS bearer context status with the MME, on indication of "back to E-UTRAN coverage" from the lower layers, the UE shall send a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message that includes the EPS bearer context status IE to the MME"
Start State: UE is in an active state with an ongoing BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION procedure and timer T3481 running.
Condition: Timer T3481 expires for the first time.
Action: The UE resends the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST, resets and restarts timer T3481. This retransmission is repeated four times. On the fifth expiry of timer T3481, the UE aborts the procedure, releases the PTI allocated for this activation, and enters the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE. If the UE had initiated resource release for all traffic flows for the bearer, it deactivates the EPS bearer context locally without peer-to-peer signalling. Upon indication of "back to E-UTRAN coverage" from the lower layers, the UE sends a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with the EPS bearer context status IE to the MME.
End State: UE is in the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE, and the EPS bearer context is deactivated locally if applicable. The EPS bearer context status is synchronized with the MME upon re-entering E-UTRAN coverage.
